HMLR_UNUSUAL_EXTENT_HEIGHT_DEPTH
The application must state the included or excluded height or depth.
HMLR_REGISTER_REFLECTS_DEED_VERTICAL_DESCRIPTION
The register and title plan reflect the deed's stated vertical inclusions and exclusions.
HMLR_OS_DATUM_FINE_TOLERANCE
Ordnance Survey datum can define height to fine tolerances.
HMLR_OPEN_FRONTAGE_WORDS_IMPOSSIBLE
Open-plan frontages can make property divisions impossible to describe unambiguously in words.
HMLR_OLD_DEVELOPMENT_WORDS_IMPOSSIBLE
Older developments with access ways or outbuildings may be impossible to define verbally.
HMLR_FULLY_DEFINED_POSTAL_POSSIBLE
A property fully defined by mapped detail may be registrable from a postal description.
HMLR_TITLE_REFERENCE_PART_WORDS
A whole title-plan reference can sometimes be transferred or leased by verbal description.
HMLR_PART_OF_REFERENCE_NEEDS_PLAN
A verbal description is not suitable when only part of an existing title-plan reference is disposed.
HMLR_ALTERNATIVE_TO_REQUISITION
HM Land Registry may complete a title plan and issue observations instead of raising requisitions.
HMLR_OCCUPIED_EXTENT_DIFFERENCE
This alternative may be used where claimed land falls outside the occupied extent shown on current mapping.
HMLR_ALREADY_REGISTERED_OTHER_OWNER
This alternative may be used where claimed land is already registered to another owner.
HMLR_NOT_IN_SELLER_TITLE
This alternative may be used where claimed land is not in the seller's or landlord's title.
HMLR_APPLICANT_CAN_RESPOND_OBSERVATIONS
Applicants may respond to observations accompanying an adjusted title plan.
HMLR_OLD_DEED_PLAN_EXCEPTION
An old deed plan used for first registration may be accepted even when it cannot precisely identify the land.
HMLR_PART_DOCUMENT_PLAN_SIGN_RULE213
A plan in a document dealing with part of registered land must be signed to comply with rule 213.
HMLR_CONVEYANCER_SIGN_ON_BEHALF
A conveyancer may sign a plan on behalf of the disponor or applicant with an endorsement.
HMLR_FULL_LAND_DESCRIPTION
A registration application must contain a full description of the land.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_POSTAL_NUMBER
The full description should include the postal number or house name where possible.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_FLOOR
The full description should include the floor level where applicable.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_ROAD
The full description should include the road name.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_LOCALITY
The full description should include the locality.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_TOWN
The full description should include the town.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_ADMIN_AREA
The full description should include the administrative area.
HMLR_DESCRIPTION_POSTCODE
The full description should include the postcode.
HMLR_PLAN_DESCRIPTION_CURRENT
The deed plan and written description should reflect the current state of the property.
HMLR_OLD_DESCRIPTION_MISLEADING
Carrying forward an old description can be misleading after part of the land has been sold.
HMLR_PROPERTY_REFERENCE_METHODS
Property extent may be defined by colouring, edging, hatching or stippling.
HMLR_ELECTRONIC_VISIBILITY
Plan markings must remain clearly visible when lodged electronically.
HMLR_EASEMENT_CURRENT_CHECK
Beneficial easements should be checked to confirm they remain exercisable.
HMLR_AREA_MEASUREMENT_NOT_REQUIRED
An area measurement is not required for the land.
HMLR_LARGER_SCALE_NO_LARGER_TITLE_PLAN
Using a larger deed-plan scale does not produce a larger-scale title plan.
HMLR_CERTIFIED_COPY_IDENTICAL
A plan attached to a certified copy of a deed must match the original in every respect.
HMLR_OS_BASE_COMMON
Ordnance Survey mapping is the most common acceptable deed-plan base.
HMLR_APPROVED_ESTATE_BASE_COMMON
An approved estate layout plan is another common acceptable base.
HMLR_ACCURATE_SCALE_OTHER_BASE
Another plan base can be acceptable if accurately drawn to scale and compliant with the guidance.
HMLR_HAND_SKETCH_FORBIDDEN
Hand-drawn sketches must not be used.
HMLR_NO_OS_EXTRACT_SUPPLY
HM Land Registry cannot supply extracts of its Ordnance Survey mapping for conveyancing.
HMLR_ARCHITECTURAL_PLAN_PRIMARY_PURPOSE
Architectural plans are usually designed for a purpose other than defining title extent.
HMLR_ENGINEERING_PLAN_PRIMARY_PURPOSE
Engineering plans are usually designed for a purpose other than defining title extent.
HMLR_LOCATION_PLAN_SCALE_TOO_SMALL
A location plan or road map is often too small-scale to define an extent accurately.
HMLR_AMBIGUOUS_EXISTING_PLAN_REJECTED
An existing plan prepared for another purpose is rejected if the extent remains ambiguous.
HMLR_OLD_DEED_CURRENT_OS_RELATION
An old deed plan can support registration if its extent can be related to current Ordnance Survey mapping.
HMLR_OLD_DEED_SOLD_OFF_CHECK
Old deeds require attention to land previously sold off.
HMLR_ADDITIONAL_PLAN_UNSIGNED_UNREGISTERED
An additional first-registration plan based on old deeds need not be signed by the parties.
HMLR_REDUCED_PLAN_BAR_SCALE
A reduced plan is acceptable when it contains a bar scale and remains unambiguous.
HMLR_REDUCED_PLAN_STATEMENT
Without a bar scale, a reduced plan should state that it is a reduced copy.
HMLR_REDUCED_PLAN_DELETE_ORIGINAL_SCALE
Without a bar scale, the original scale should be deleted from a reduced plan.
